name: Bitsight Cybersecurity Glossary
description: Bitsight Cybersecurity Glossary — 119 terms across attack-surface management, cyber-risk scoring, vendor risk, and security ratings vocabulary. Tightly aligned with Bitsight's security-rating product domain.
relationToCloudSecurity: Indirect — many terms apply broadly (attack surface, security posture, vendor risk); some are Bitsight-product-flavored.

license.notes: Vendor marketing content — copyright Bitsight. Internal CSA use only — extracted derivatives are not redistributable. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).

current_extraction.notes:
Two-stage fetch: (1) tools-resources/utils/playwright_fetch.py captured the JS-hydrated index page (auto mode, networkidle + 8s dwell) into .source-cache.html; (2) the extractor parses 119 .definition-block deep-link URLs from that cache, then politely fetches each per-term page (1.5s delay) and extracts the term's article > first

. Per-term pages are plain server-rendered HTML, no JS / no anti-bot.

extraction_history.reason: Initial metadata stub created from glossary research sweep
Extracted via requests + BeautifulSoup per PROCESSING-GLOSSARIES.md workflow

notes: First demonstration of the hub-harvest + per-term-page-fetch pattern documented in PROCESSING-GLOSSARIES.md. Reusable for other JS-rendered SPAs where the index hydrates but content lives on per-term pages (Forescout, F5, etc. follow the same architecture). Re-run sequence: re-capture index via playwright_fetch.py, then re-run this script.

desired_end_state.notes: Vendor-copyrighted glossary; redistribution not permitted without authorization. Stub here is the public-dataset's complete representation — the structured terms (if extracted) live in the companion private repo dataset-private-laws-regulations-standards. No public-side gap.
